description: This file defines a Java interface named Placeholder that represents a placeholder expression with a method to resolve placeholder variables by name from a given source.

classes.name: Placeholder
classes.description: A generic interface representing a placeholder expression that can resolve placeholder variables of type T.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder variable by name based on the provided source. Returns an Optional containing the value if supported, or an empty Optional otherwise.
